# Command reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

A command is the one way to change a project (`Command` → `Transaction` → `Op`). The same command runs from the user interface, from a command log replayed by `ew apply`, from scripts and from the Session API. Each page below gives the command's registry entry, its parameters with types and constraints, and the exit codes of `ew apply`.

73 commands, from the parameter schemas in [`crates/ew-commands/schemas`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/tree/main/crates/ew-commands/schemas). The catalogue of the command registry is [doc 17 §2.1](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#21-command-registry).

| Command | Summary | Cost | Exposure | Stability |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`assembly.attach`](assembly.attach.md) | `assembly.attach` (`AttachChildren`): makes existing devices children of a parent device (doc 03 §7: modules of a valve terminal under its head device, a mounting plate under its enclosure), with their positions (FR-DEV-022: child order is `Device.position`, never the drawing). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`bond.create`](bond.create.md) | `bond.create` (`CreateBond`): declares a bond, a link of two potentials that does not merge them (doc 03 §9.6, doc 08 §3.7; FR-CON-014, the "declare bond" quick fix of EW-POT-001). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`box.black`](box.black.md) | `box.black` (`PlaceBlackBox`, doc 06 §2.7, §3.1): places a black box, a function of kind `black_box` drawn with the black-box symbol and its page geometry. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`box.reshape`](box.reshape.md) | `box.reshape` (`ReshapeBox`, FR-DEV-039): replaces the outline of a black box (a representation with a `box`), and its connection points with `cps`, or re-projects them onto the new outline. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`box.structure`](box.structure.md) | `box.structure` (`CreateStructureBox`, WP-S2.04 §5.1, §10.1; FR-PRJ-020): creates a structure box on a page: its outline (absolute page nm, at least three vertices, which need not lie on the connection grid), its style (`dotted` or `dash_dot`), an optional caption, the structure it assigns (one slot per aspect: a node, `none`, or absent to leave the page's) and the external point it stands for. Which representations it encloses is derived, never stored (`rep_structure_box`). An empty caption is not stored. Rejected: fewer than three vertices (at `/outline`); a node of `assigns` that does not exist or is not of its slot's aspect (at `/assigns/<aspect>`); an external reference that does not exist (at `/external`); a missing page (not found). Interactive. Outcome: the box. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`bus.logical_net.create`](bus.logical_net.create.md) | `bus.logical_net.create` (`CreateLogicalNet`): a logical bus network, the scope of address uniqueness with its master and rate (doc 10 §2.7, FR-BUS-002). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`bus.physical_net.create`](bus.physical_net.create.md) | `bus.physical_net.create` (`CreatePhysicalNet`): a physical bus network, whose segments are derived from the `Bus` connections and the connectors (doc 10 §2.7, FR-BUS-003). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`cable.create`](cable.create.md) | a cable device with its conductors (doc 03 §12). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`check.unwaive`](check.unwaive.md) | `check.unwaive` (`UnwaiveFinding`): removes a waiver (doc 15 §2.5, FR-CHK-009; WP-S1.16 D7), after which its finding counts again. Rejected: a waiver that does not exist (at `/waiver`). **Exposure `HumanOnly`**, as `check.waive`. Interactive; undoable as one step. Outcome: none. | interactive | human_only | preview |
| [`check.waive`](check.waive.md) | `check.waive` (`WaiveFinding`): records a waiver that accepts one finding (doc 15 §2.5, FR-CHK-009; WP-S1.16 D7, FT-494): `Waiver {rule, target: {finding}, reason, author, date}` with a new ID. | interactive | human_only | preview |
| [`conductor.add`](conductor.add.md) | conductors of an existing cable. Rejected: the device has no cable aspect; a core already used in the cable or twice in the list. Outcome: the first new conductor. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`connection.delete`](connection.delete.md) | removes connections through the delete policies (they leave junction sequences; bonds lose their `via`). A junction left with two or fewer connections is cleaned up by normaliser #8. Every connection must exist. Outcome: none. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`connection.draw`](connection.draw.md) | `connection.draw` (`Connect`, doc 06 §3.5, §4.4): one explicit connection. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`connection.draw_many`](connection.draw_many.md) | `connection.draw_many` (`ConnectMany`, cycle 33): several `Connect`s, in the given order, in **one** transaction (one undo step). Edit ▸ Bridge terminals draws the chain of bridges over three or more terminals of a strip with it (BR1 = 1-2, 2-3, 3-4). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`connection.draw_to_ip`](connection.draw_to_ip.md) | `connection.draw_to_ip` (`DrawToIp`, doc 06 §4.4 "P", WP-S2.04 §5.1, §9.2): a wire that ends in a new interruption point, in one transaction and one undo step. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`connection.route`](connection.route.md) | replaces a connection's route (FR-CON-007). Connectivity is unchanged. On a page the route must be on the page's connection grid and its ends must meet their CPs (D3, `geometry::require_route`). Outcome: the connection. Coalesce route drags with a key. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`device.create`](device.create.md) | a device without a representation (FR-DEV-001), optionally with its main function. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`device.link`](device.link.md) | `device.link` (`LinkDevices`, doc 11 §4.3 `device.link{from, to, Drives}`): a functional link between two devices, such as a valve that drives a field device (doc 11 §3.3: the PLC overview and the I/O list print the driven device's process tag). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`device.place`](device.place.md) | `device.place` (`PlaceSymbol`, doc 06 §3.3): places a symbol and creates the device and function as the target requires. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`edit.delete`](edit.delete.md) | removes the selected records with everything the delete policies take along (FR-DEV-030), in **one** delete plan for all targets (`TxBuilder::delete_many`): the result does not depend on the order of the targets, a target that another target's cascade removes is planned once, and a target listed twice counts once. Deleting a representation leaves its function unplaced (an IP function goes with it); deleting a device removes its functions, their representations and connections. A target that does not exist at the start is `NotFound`; a forbid link (a strip with terminals, a referenced structure node) rejects the whole command (`ModelError::Referenced`). Cost: `Bulk` when the plan removes or changes more than 500 records (D4; the plan is computed once by `cost`). A released or withdrawn revision is immutable (FR-REV-009): naming one is refused at `/targets/<i>`; the open revision may be deleted. A deleted page takes the open revision's note on it along (FT-303, WP-S1.18 D5). Outcome: none. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`edit.paste`](edit.paste.md) | pastes a project fragment onto `page` with its anchor at `at` (doc 06 §3.6, FR-DEV-029, FR-UI-036, FR-UI-040), in one transaction (one undo step removes the records and the embedded copies). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`external_ref.create`](external_ref.create.md) | `external_ref.create` (`CreateExternalRef`): a point outside the project that an interruption point or a structure box can name (doc 03 §6, FR-XRF-011): a device, and optionally its connection, at a location node, optionally in another project ("JE-N1000-03", connection "L", at +J-E-206). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`fields.set`](fields.set.md) | `fields.set` (`SetFields`): sets one field on one or more records of one kind. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`fields.set_many`](fields.set_many.md) | `fields.set_many` (`SetManyFields`, WP-S2.05 part 2; FR-DEV-032, FR-UI-020): sets one value per (kind, targets, path) entry, the entries in the given order, in **one** transaction (one undo step). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`ip.arrange`](ip.arrange.md) | `ip.arrange` (`ArrangeIps`, FR-XRF-013, WP-S2.04 §5.1, D12): interruption points of one page exchanged into a new order. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`ip.continue`](ip.continue.md) | the partner of an interruption point on another page (FR-XRF-014). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`ip.place`](ip.place.md) | an interruption point (FR-XRF-006 … FR-XRF-014, doc 03 §10): the IP function and its one representation in one transaction (EW-INV-013). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`item.place`](item.place.md) | `item.place` (`PlaceItem`, WP-S2.04 §5.1; FR-SYM-023, FR-SYM-024, FR-SYM-025): creates a page item on a page, a graphic (`{"graphic": {shape, stroke?, dash?, fill?}}`), a free text (`{"free_text": {text, bind?, at, angle?, style?, align?}}`) or an image (`{"image": {asset \| data, rect}}`, part 5: an asset of the project's store, or the image file as base64 `data`, which the command validates and stores as the company logo is stored, in the rectangle of two opposite corners, stored with the smaller coordinates first), absolute in page nm; a rectangle is stored with `min` the smaller coordinates. Rejected: a missing page (not found); a degenerate shape (a zero-length line, a polyline or polygon with fewer than two or three distinct points, a rectangle without area, a radius of 0, an arc without sweep) or a stroke width of 0 or less, at `/kind/graphic`; a `bind` that is not one of the six bindable names, an empty `text` without `bind`, or an angle other than 0, 90000, 180000 or 270000, at `/kind/free_text`; an image with both or neither of `asset` and `data`, or whose rectangle has no area, at `/kind/image`; one whose asset the project does not hold, at `/kind/image/asset`; one whose `data` is no accepted image file (the logo's checks and texts), at `/kind/image/data`. Interactive. Outcome: the item. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`junction.edit`](junction.edit.md) | style, wiring and sequence of a junction (FR-CON-005, doc 06 §3.5). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`library.embed`](library.embed.md) | `library.embed` (`EmbedLibraryCopies`): embeds library items into the project, each as a copy that carries its lineage `{library_id, item_id, version, sha256}` (doc 05 §13.2), such as the frame form without grid that generated section dividers and report pages need (doc 20 §20.2 step 4). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`library.update`](library.update.md) | `library.update` (`UpdateLibraryCopies`, WP-S1.19 D9, doc 07 §4.5, FR-PRT-014, FR-SYM-016): replaces held library copies by other versions of the same items, in place (same copy ID), remapping the connection points the change moves. | bulk | edit | preview |
| [`macro.insert`](macro.insert.md) | `macro.insert` (`InsertMacro`, WP-S1.19 D13, doc 07 §3.5 and §4.6, FR-MAC-002 to FR-MAC-005, FR-MAC-018): inserts a window macro onto `page` with its anchor at `at`, turned and mirrored about the anchor by `orient` first (FT-672), or a page macro's pages after `page`, in one transaction (one undo step). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`marker.place`](marker.place.md) | `marker.place` (`PlaceMarker`, WP-S2.04 §5.1; FR-CON-023, FR-CON-039): places the group wire marker of several connections of one page. One transaction: on each connection `overrides.show_marker` becomes true, `overrides.csa` becomes `csa` when given and `overrides.colour` becomes `colours[i]` when given; then a page item `{"wire_marker": {connections, at, angle, fields: ["csa", "colour"]}}` lists the connections in the given (printed) order. The marker displays the connections' effective values; it stores none of its own (doc 08 §4.5). Nothing derived is read. Rejected: no connection, or one listed twice (at `/connections`); a connection that does not exist (not found) or is not drawn on `page` (at `/connections/<i>`); an angle other than 0 or 90000 (at `/angle`); `colours` neither empty nor one per connection (at `/colours`); a colour that is neither an IEC 60757 code nor a company code of the project's colour profile (at `/colours/<i>`, FR-CON-019); a missing page (not found). Interactive. Outcome: the marker. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`numbering.renumber`](numbering.renumber.md) | `numbering.renumber` (`RenumberDevices`): renumbers device counters under the page-based scheme. | bulk | edit | preview |
| [`page.create`](page.create.md) | a new drawn page (FR-PAG-005, doc 06 §5.6). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`page.delete`](page.delete.md) | removes pages with everything they own (FR-PAG-025, doc 06 §3.4). | bulk | edit | preview |
| [`page.renumber`](page.renumber.md) | renumbers folio numbers (FR-PAG-007). References are by ID, so every xref, tag and TOC row follows without further ops. | bulk | edit | preview |

| [`part.edit_copy`](part.edit_copy.md) | `part.edit_copy` (`EditPartCopy`, WP-S2.07 D20, D21; FT-394): edits the identity, description, category, unit and technical data of a part copy the project holds, in one undo step. Always previewed (`Bulk`). | bulk | edit | preview |
| [`parts.import`](parts.import.md) | `parts.import` (`ImportParts`, FT-410): creates project-local part copies, the one command that does (a copy of another library is embedded with `library.embed`, which refuses project-local items), with the project-local manufacturer copies the parts name (WP-S1.19 D10). | bulk | edit | preview |

| [`project.checks.set`](project.checks.set.md) | `project.checks.set` (`SetCheckSchemes`): names the project's check schemes (doc 03 §15 `CheckSettings`): the online scheme of the message panel (`active_scheme`, default `drafting`) and the scheme of the release gate and `ew check` (`release_scheme`, default `pre-delivery`, doc 15 §3.2). | interactive | human_only | preview |
